name: Facebook Feed Post
strategic_objective: Community interaction, storytelling, conversation, and relationship-building through flexible post formats.

tone: Warm, narrative, and community-first. Clear, human, and dialog-oriented.
copywriting_rules: The first line must trigger curiosity or relevance before the 'see more' cut. Use short paragraphs, natural language, and conversational framing. Prioritize questions, stories, or relatable moments over announcements.
Line 1: hook or tension. Lines 2–4: story, context, or explanation. Final line: direct question or participation-driven CTA.
Do not rely on hashtags for reach. Discovery is driven by engagement signals.
Tag people, partners, or locations only when relevant to the content to stimulate replies and secondary visibility.

hard_constraints: Long, dense text blocks with no spacing
Using hashtags as a primary discovery tactic
